status_note: Written before computing any of the tests below. The discovery/holdout split of the existing event study (holdout from 2024-10-16) was already viewed for CEO/CFO and cluster buys at 1/5/20/60d, so the holdout is NOT pristine for those cells; forward paper trading is the only clean test.
hypothesis: Discretionary open-market purchases by insiders (especially CEO/CFO, or several insiders together) reveal private valuation views not yet in price (Seyhun 1986; Lakonishok-Lee 2001; Cohen-Malloy-Pomorski 2012). Prediction: positive abnormal return over the first 1-5 sessions after the Form 4 becomes public, decaying thereafter.

event.source: SEC Form 4 non-derivative table, transaction code P, not flagged as 10b5-1
event.primary_trigger: filing by a CEO/CFO (title match) OR completion of a cluster (>=2 distinct insiders with code-P filings within 30 calendar days)
event.timing: public at filing date; entry at the open of the first session strictly after the filing date; exit at the open h sessions later
event.dedup: at most one event per issuer per 20 sessions (primary horizon x4); later triggers inside an open window are ignored
event.liquidity_screen: 60-session average dollar volume >= $20m and close >= $5 on the session before entry (point-in-time)

primary.return: open-to-open stock return minus beta*SPY open-to-open return, beta from the 252 sessions before entry

section_3_3_controls.matched_controls: per event, the universe stock in the same SIC sector with nearest log dollar volume and nearest 12-1 momentum rank, with no code-P filing in +/-90 days; difference-in-CAR test
section_3_3_controls.earnings: 8-K item 2.02 filings; report results with and without events whose holding window contains an earnings release
section_3_3_controls.incremental_value: OLS of CAR_h on event dummy (events + matched controls) with momentum, 1m reversal, log dollar volume, beta, sector fixed effects; SEs clustered by month
section_3_3_controls.subgroups: sector, dollar-volume tercile, regime (SPY>200d x VIX vs 5y median) - descriptive, no gating

PAPER_TEST_ELIGIBLE_requires_all: discovery mean net-of-cost abnormal return > 0 with month-clustered t >= 3.0
deflated Sharpe ratio >= 0.90 on the discovery daily portfolio series, trials = 1 primary + 11 secondary
holdout mean net abnormal return > 0 (sign check only; holdout already partly viewed)
gate.never_automatic: LIVE_REVIEW_ELIGIBLE requires >= 3 months of forward paper trading reviewed by the user

frozen_parameters: no parameter in this file may change after results are seen without registering insider-event-v2
